title: Replace admin authentication with new three-step verification codes + new master override code

requirements.text: Update the backend’s active Admin verification credentials so that Admin Dashboard access requires successful completion of the three-step sequence using the newly provided Code #1, Code #2, and Code #3 (in that exact order), and ensure the new Master Override Code is the only master override credential accepted for master-override verification and code rotation.

quotes: the first step is typing in this code: A7kP3x9LmQ2R8tY5Zn6Cw1DgH the second step is typing in this code: J4sT8bN2Kp5Xq7M9Lr3Wc6V1a the third step is typing in this code: Z9Hf2Qw8Rk4Tn7Yp6B3C5m1Ls
This is the master overwrite code: A7kP3x9LmQ2R8tY5Zn6Cw1DgHJ4sT8bN2Kp5Xq7M9Lr3Wc6V1aZ9Hf2Qw8Rk4Tn7Yp6B3C5m1LsM2e8Pq4R7t9U1v5W6x3Y0Zk2a
this should replace the current admin authentication system! Build it!

acceptanceCriteria: After deployment, a caller cannot obtain a valid admin session unless they submit Code #1, then Code #2, then Code #3 successfully (or successfully verify via the Master Override Code path if supported).
The backend accepts the provided Master Override Code and rejects the prior/previous master override credential (if any).
The backend accepts the provided Code #1/#2/#3 and rejects the prior/previous code values (if any).

requirements.text: Ensure the new Code #1/#2/#3 and the new Master Override Code are treated as secrets: do not embed their plaintext values anywhere in the frontend bundle, and do not log them to browser console, backend logs, or error messages; store/validate them server-side in a way suitable for rotation (e.g., hashed/derived representation rather than plaintext).

quotes: the first step is typing in this code: A7kP3x9LmQ2R8tY5Zn6Cw1DgH ...
This is the master overwrite code: A7kP3x9LmQ2R8tY5Zn6Cw1DgHJ4sT8bN2Kp5Xq7M9Lr3Wc6V1aZ9Hf2Qw8Rk4Tn7Yp6B3C5m1LsM2e8Pq4R7t9U1v5W6x3Y0Zk2a

acceptanceCriteria: No UI text, client-side constants, network responses, or console logs expose any of the plaintext codes.
Backend error messages returned to the frontend do not contain any code values.
The backend does not persist the provided codes in plaintext form in stable state.

requirements.text: Keep the Admin Dashboard closed off: all /admin routes and all admin-only backend mutations must remain protected by the admin verification session (three-step verification), and must not become publicly accessible.

quotes: it is not being public anymore it is completely closed off from everybody
once all three of these codes are typed in you get full access to the admin panel/dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting any /admin route without a valid admin verification session shows the verification gate and does not render admin content.
All backend methods currently guarded by admin verification continue to trap/deny when the caller does not have a valid admin verification session.
Non-admin public website features remain accessible as before.

requirements.text: Add upgrade-safe initialization/migration so that existing deployments are updated to use the newly provided Code #1/#2/#3 and Master Override Code values (without requiring the old codes to be known), while preserving existing per-principal permanent lockout state.

quotes: this should replace the current admin authentication system!

acceptanceCriteria: After an upgrade from an existing canister state, the canister uses the newly provided codes for verification.
All principals previously marked as permanently locked out remain permanently locked out after the upgrade.
Any existing in-progress admin verification sessions are invalidated as part of the credential replacement (security reset), except that permanent lockouts remain enforced.

requirements.text: Update the frontend Admin verification UX copy (gate screen and verification-code management page) as needed so it accurately reflects the system behavior: three steps in order (Step 1/3, 2/3, 3/3) and Master Override Code for code rotation, without referencing any retired/previous admin authentication system.

quotes: adding a three-step verification system to the admins panel
within the dashboard there is a little section where you can type in this code it is called the master override code which allows me to change the three main codes

acceptanceCriteria: The admin gate screen clearly indicates Step 1/3, Step 2/3, Step 3/3 with ordered progression.
The Verification Code Management page continues to require the Master Override Code before allowing code rotation.
No user-facing text instructs users to use any old/previous admin authentication mechanism.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if required for upgrade/migration.

Do not edit files under frontend immutablePaths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not make any admin routes or admin APIs public.
Do not change unrelated shop, portfolio, testimonials, giveaways, coupons, or marketing-site content beyond what is necessary for admin authentication replacement.
Do not add any third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
